# Syntalix Consultancy (Syntalix LLP)

> Syntalix Consultancy is the trading name of Syntalix LLP (LLPIN ACR-6280), a software, AI and ML development company based in Uttar Pradesh, India. We design and build web and mobile platforms, LLM features, agentic AI systems and machine learning infrastructure for clients in India, the United States and Europe. Working since 2023, registered as an LLP in 2025, certified by the Wadhwani NEN Foundation.

Not to be confused with other companies using the name "Syntalix". Our only website is https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com and our LinkedIn page is https://www.linkedin.com/company/syntalix-llp/.

## Services

- [Web and mobile app development](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/web-mobile-development): websites, booking platforms, SaaS and mobile apps.
- [LLM engineering](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/llm-engineering): RAG architecture, fine-tuning, evaluation, guardrails and production APIs.
- [Agentic AI systems](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/agentic-systems): multi-agent workflows that use tools and escalate to people.
- [AI and machine learning infrastructure](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/ai-ml-infrastructure): training pipelines, MLOps, model serving and monitoring.
- [AI consulting](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/ai-consulting): use-case discovery, costed roadmaps and proofs of concept.
- [Answer engine optimisation](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/aeo-optimization): structured data, entity clarity and answer-ready content.

## Client work

- [City Farmers case study](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/case-studies/city-farmers): an AI grow-guide web app with retrieval-based answers that cite their source.
- [RapidLink Logistics case study](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/case-studies/rapidlink-logistics): a booking, payments and tracking platform.
- [Portfolio](https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/portfolio): live client sites (Legal India, RAYS & RZILSS, JT Makeovers) and AI systems delivered for clients.
